agents teams add phnx-3940-build claude 'Implement PHNX-3940 automatic managed harness updates in your dedicated linked worktree from latest origin/main. You are not alone: another worker owns versions.ts/accounts.ts/account-catalog, parent owns view.ts/exec.ts/plan; do not revert others or edit those files. OWN: installations/{types,store,strategies,update}.ts and adjacent tests; new installations/update-policy.ts and update-runtime.ts as needed; daemon harness-update-service and catalog/daemon registration; commands/update.ts; config-keys.ts/device-config.ts/commands/config.ts + tests; relevant daemon docs. No separate PR/release/ticket/feed. Commit your focused changes to your branch and push it; parent integrates into ONE PR. Read relevant AGENTS.md. Use blessed test wrapper on worker (not laptop).

Product contract: default-on agents-managed automatic update for safely transactional isolated npm harnesses incl Claude/Codex; settings agents config set updates.auto false|true and per-harness updates.<harness>.auto false|true. Preserve ALL existing homes/credentials, labels, defaults, config and sessions. Reuse existing updateInstallation, not reenable vendor DISABLE_AUTOUPDATER/check_for_update. Optional Installation.updatePolicy '\''latest'\''|'\''pinned'\'' schema1; absent legacy means latest; explicit manual --to concrete pins, --to latest unpins. commands update bare harness updates ALL eligible installations, @label selects only one. Add --check machine-readable dry-run of eligibility/current/target/policy/deferral, and internal daemon flag if needed. Daemon single supervised service every15min startup60s; run work via bounded child process to keep sync installation IO off daemon loop; configurable and abort-safe.

Safety FIRST: existing npm swap incomplete rollback on mid-commit exception; update.ts finalizes before recordRelease (record failure then cannot undo). Fix. Serialize concurrent updates with cross-process lock, reload record under lock, fail closed on corrupt metadata. Defer active harnesses based on real process state INCLUDING native direct shims (not just our session registry). Prevent launch/update race through canonical exec/shim lease coordination if needed; coordinate interface with parent before touching exec/shims (parent can implement gate). Retain rollback on failure; no session termination. Policy change while staging must prevent automatic commit. No auto for unsupported/nontransactional strategies; report manual/vendor-managed honestly. Resolve latest once per harness/pass to avoid N network calls. No credential refresh/probe/token output.

Need send parent your API contract early via teams message (team phnx-3940-build teammate root may not exist; report concise text in session and parent reads). Parent needs exported policy getter and update process CLI invocation. New tests beside source with real temp filesystem/processes, no mock vendor network. Tests meaningful for rollback, concurrency, pinned/off, active processes, legacy home preservation. Fetch updated source before work. User expects shipped result, not research. Finish implementation then commit+push+report commands evidence and limitations.' --name updates --device worker-s0 --worktree phnx-3940-updates --mode auto --task-type implement --json
